en: Iyolin - With this victory at the fortress, we seem to have broken most of the Imperial garrison in Pandragon.
Daicus - What remains in Pandragon is a small garrison and the stragglers from this battle. In that case, marching on Pandragon should not be hard.
Erich - The armies of Pandragon, Cutis, Dagal and our Astania fighting side by side... You could truly call it the return of Silver Arrow after all these years.
Arcia - Now that it has come to this, we should formally revive the Silver Arrow alliance. Before we march on Pandragon, we will need to sort out our units and chain of command anyway.
Daicus - Then by tradition, shouldn't Princess Iyolin, heir of Pandragon, take command?
Erich - I agree with Prince Daicus. By her deeds and by tradition alike, it is only natural for the alliance to move under her command.
Arcia - And since our cause is to retake Pandragon, she is the right choice.

Iyolin - Then I will not refuse. Retaking Pandragon comes first. And if we win a great victory in Pandragon, I believe an attack on the Imperial homeland will become possible. For now, let us rest for a few days while each of us summons our best troops from home to form a new alliance army.
